data.long_meaning: The name Doug is of Old English origin, derived from the term 'dūg,' meaning 'dark' or 'stranger'. The name was commonly used in Scotland and Ireland. In the Middle Ages, it was also given to the sons of Viking warriors, reflecting the Norse influence in Scotland and Ireland. The name Doug carries the meaning “Germanic: Dark Stranger” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
